note: Byte/codec fixtures are CPU-only and exact (pinned at baseline). The throughput/VRAM matrices are GPU b-phase. given/when/then with exact assertions below.

valid.given: each codec bf16 / fp8 / nvfp4 on a supported pool (MHA FULL, hybrid-SWA, QSA)
valid.when: create the pool and read its payload_bytes/scale_bytes per token
valid.then: packed codes + sidecar scales match the codec table exactly
valid.assertion: nvfp4 = packed E2M1 + E4M3 block scales + fp32 row scales; fp8 = e4m3 + fp32 row scales; byte tests exact

valid.given: expert cache slots fixed at 2600, 16k context, same checkpoint
valid.then: the only varying factor is the KV codec restore/read path
valid.assertion: record output tok/s and PPL per codec at identical slots; raw rows unedited

valid.then: smaller KV frees expert slots; the system effect is slots + miss + tok/s
valid.assertion: record resolved slots, miss rate and tok/s per codec

invalid_negative.given: fp8 measures faster than bf16 in comparison B (same VRAM)
invalid_negative.then: if the fp8 advantage disappears at equal slots, it is the extra expert residency, not the codec
invalid_negative.assertion: report A and B; the codec verdict is taken from A only

invalid_negative.given: 4k context, where KV bytes are a small fraction
invalid_negative.then: dequant overhead can make quant slower with no capacity benefit; do not claim a low-context win
invalid_negative.assertion: per-context reporting only; no pooling across contexts

invalid_negative.given: DSA/MLA (pending) or DSV4 paged / BSA (no scale-read path) with a quant codec
invalid_negative.then: raise loudly; never silently serve a 16-bit slab priced as packed
invalid_negative.assertion: DSA/MLA -> NotImplementedError; DSV4 paged and BSA -> ValueError

invalid_negative.given: a KV group with head_dim not divisible by 16
bf16 KV at 220k (25,358 B/token ~= 5.56 GiB) alongside the expert cache
invalid_negative.then: expected to OOM; it is a reported skip, not a zero
invalid_negative.assertion: OOM row recorded separately; never averaged into the mean
